profile.name: SPCX Watch
profile.description: Weekday pre-market brief for NASDAQ:SPCX (SpaceX). Tracks SEC filings, analyst targets, Starlink licenses, official X accounts, Mach33 research, and AI data-center news. Quiet sections say nothing new.

memory.content: Every weekday brief must scan analyst ratings and price targets: upgrade / downgrade / initiate / resume, plus each named analyst's PT change (firm, analyst name if public, old rating → new rating, old PT → new PT in USD, date, clickable link). A PT-only change with no rating change still gets listed. No change: write nothing new. If a PT number is not published, mark unpublished — never invent it. Three or more same-direction upgrades or downgrades can be high conviction; a single firm is mediu

Country licenses and spectrum are core brief work, not optional. Every weekday search: Starlink license, Starlink granted licence, Starlink regulator, Starlink Spectrum Holdings, plus FCC fcc.gov (Starlink / SpaceX / WT / IB docket). Sources must include regulator press and telecom trade (TDRA, Ofcom, Anatel, ARN, WAM, Telecompaper, Light Reading). Do not mark the policy section quiet from Reuters / Ars / CNBC / SpaceX.com alone. A new national license, spectrum acquisition, transfer, permanent

Weekdays 5:45: for @elonmusk, capture every original post and reply since the last successful scan (include replies, retweets may be excluded, use start_time or paginate until the window is covered). The other four accounts @SpaceX @spacexai @grok @bot stay at max_results=15, include replies, no pagination.

Official X connector plugin 49086599 is required for the five-account sweep and discussion-volume counts. Read the bundled x-mcp-guide before any X call. Probe with a cheap lookup first. A 503 on usage credits is not an empty balance. Do not tell the user to buy credits unless the balance is about $0.

Every weekday, treat FCC open-meeting / Spectrum Abundance / satellite broadband spectrum agenda (12 GHz, 42 GHz, Ku, Ka, D-band, D2D, unlicensed-to-satellite) as required alongside the FCC docket sweep. Do not treat a single D2D NPRM as covering a Spectrum Abundance order or FNPRM. FCC spectrum M&A, transfers, waivers, build-out, and abundance reallocation can stand alone as high conviction.

Every weekday SPCX brief must scan Mach33 Financial Group material from Aaron Burnett and Vlad Saigau (site 33fg.com / SpaceX premium research, LinkedIn, and their X accounts @aaronburnett @VladSaigau @mach33). Include new notes, model updates, earnings reactions, valuation/BFM commentary, livestreams, and PT-relevant takes with links. Route under Analyst ratings / Medium or High as warranted; do not invent unpublished PTs. Quiet if nothing new since last successful scan.

Mach33 research MCP is available at https://research.33fg.com/mcp — add and connect it for SPCX Watch SpaceX premium research scans alongside 33fg.com / LinkedIn / X. Prefer the MCP when connected; fall back to web/X if auth fails.
